description: Defines MainActivityViewModel class managing UI state for MainActivity, including user data and theme preferences, using Kotlin coroutines and Flow.

classes.name: MainActivityUiState
classes.description: Sealed interface representing UI states: Loading and Success with user data and theme preferences.

classes.name: MainActivityViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing UI state for MainActivity, injecting UserDataRepository, exposing uiState as StateFlow.

methods.name: shouldKeepSplashScreen
methods.description: Returns true if the current UI state is Loading, indicating splash screen should be shown.

methods.name: shouldUseDarkTheme
methods.description: Determines if dark theme should be used based on system theme and user preferences.
